title: CacheScope: Exact-Compute Allocation for Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2610.12530v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training-free feature reuse accelerates diffusion transformer inference by replacing full denoising computation at selected steps with cached approximations. Existing methods mainly improve the reconstruction of skipped features, but we find that once a stable first-order reconstructor is used, increasing reconstruction complexity brings limited gains, whereas the placement of exact-computation steps has a much larger effect on fidelity. More importantly, absolute shallow-probe variation is jointly affected by input-trajectory displacement and network response strength, and therefore does not directly reflect cache risk. We address this confounding by normalizing probe-output variation with the corresponding input displacement, yielding a directional gain per unit trajectory movement. translated_title: CacheScope：面向无训练扩散加速的精确计算分配方法
translated_abstract: 无训练特征复用通过在选定步骤用缓存的近似结果替代完整的去噪计算来加速扩散Transformer的推理。现有方法主要致力于改进被跳过特征的重构，但我们发现，一旦采用了稳定的一阶重构器，继续增加重构复杂度带来的收益十分有限，而精确计算步骤的放置位置对保真度的影响要大得多。更重要的是，绝对的浅层探测变化同时受输入轨迹位移和网络响应强度的共同影响，因此并不能直接反映缓存风险。我们通过用相应的输入位移对探测输出变化进行归一化来解决这一混淆问题，从而得到每单位轨迹移动的方向性增益。基于这一信号，我们提出CacheScope，它能够在线识别高风险的缓存复用步骤，并选择性地回退到完整的去噪计算。
tldr: 提出CacheScope，通过以输入位移归一化探测输出变化来在线识别高风险缓存复用步骤，并选择性回退到完整去噪计算，实现无需训练的扩散模型加速。
en_tdlr: CacheScope enables training-free diffusion acceleration by normalizing probe-output variation with input displacement to identify high-risk cache-reuse steps online and selectively falling back to full denoising computation.
